title: Mahadevuda Mahonnathuda Telugu Christian Lyrics
telugu: మహిమ నీకే ఘనత నీకే – ప్రభావము నీకే
english: Mahima neeke ghanatha neeke prabhaavamu neeke
translation: O Great God, O Most High, I will praise You.
O One full of grace, O One full of kindness, I will sing of You.
Glory belongs only to You, honor belongs to You, majesty belongs to You.
To You, to You, to You alone, my Jesus.
My Heavenly Father, who never leaves my side,
My true Father, who never forsakes me.
To bear fruit in You, to live my life for You,
You, You, You alone will I serve and worship.
Without causing Your wounds to ache or reopen again,
I will press forward guided solely by Your Spirit.
To toil for You, to live my life for You,
You, You, You alone will I proclaim to the world.
intro: Mahadevuda Mahonnathuda is the latest Telugu Christian song. This song was released on May 26, 2026, through DIVINE VISUAL STUDIO YouTube Channel.
